summary: Verified Admin Portal EN/ES i18n (iteration_36). Authenticated as super_admin via dev-login magic link, exercised the locale toggle on 17 admin surfaces plus the home + clients + 3 sub-layouts. ALL checks pass. Sidebar, Admin Home, Operations/Business/Compliance sub-layout subnavs, Clients list page (header + filter + table + buttons), and PageHeader (kicker + title + subtitle) on every page in the request's scope translate cleanly between EN and ES, including the sanctions custom header ('Screening queue / Cola de screening'). Locale toggle persistence via cookie `prosper_locale` works across navigations. Per agent-to-agent note, table-row content / KPI tooltips / embedded chart subtitles ('Tendencia diaria', 'Operations Queue', integration health strip labels) are intentionally left untranslated and were NOT flagged.
